title: Everyday Home ABC
hook: A small safe task can be enough.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D home storybook, tidy rooms, familiar household objects, simple segmentation-friendly scenes; visual identity: Everyday Home ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child joining age-appropriate home routines
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: object -> ordinary use -> adult boundary where needed
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Everyday Home ABC a daily-use cycle: open/close, sit/rest, store/retrieve, wash/dry, chill food, move laundry, and put-away—without turning chores into compulsory child labor.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child participates only in age-appropriate household routines and recognizes adult appliance/tool steps.
